run_quadruped_simulation: run the pybullet GUI simulation for the microtaur quadruped robot with adjustable joint controls
load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model into pybullet with a specified start position and movable base
reset_joint_states: reset all joint states of a pybullet robot body to predefined position values
configure_joint_control: configure position-controlled joint motors with debug parameters for each revolute or prismatic joint
simulate_with_debug_params: simulate a pybullet world in real time with user-adjustable gravity and joint target positions
